projects.name: Atlanta metro area data center land (100 acres)
projects.quote: As previously disclosed, Digital Realty acquired approximately 100 acres of land in the Atlanta metro area that is expected to support over 200 megawatts of IT capacity for approximately $120 million.

projects.name: Dallas metro area data center land (167 acres)
projects.quote: Separately, Digital Realty acquired a 167-acre land parcel in the Dallas metro area that is expected to support approximately 480 megawatts of IT capacity for approximately $11 million.

projects.name: Franklin Park campus expansion
projects.quote: Lastly, Digital Realty acquired several land parcels as part of an assemblage in the Chicago metro area supporting the continued expansion of its Franklin Park campus for approximately $6 million.
